checks.criterion: the drill files re-parsed: Excellon headers, and hole counts equal the board's
the position file lists every placed part with its side and rotation
the vendor BOM re-parsed: every fitted part listed once, the vendor's columns
the assembly drawing re-parsed as a PDF
the stack-up note carries the layer count, thickness, copper, finish and impedance
the IPC-D-356 netlist groups the board's pins exactly as the schematic's netlist does
the vendor's checklist satisfied: every deliverable of the fab profile present and non-empty
